examples.english: In areas experiencing depopulation, the decline of local industries has become a serious problem.

notes:
Refers to industries that developed in a particular area, often drawing on local raw materials, climate, or traditional craft skills. Examples include ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧ (Arita porcelain), {西陣織|にしじんおり} (Nishijin weaving), and regional food processing. These industries are central to discussions of rural revitalization and regional economic policy in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地場|じば}{産業|さんぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{振興|しんこう}→振興：00471_shinkou⟧ — promotion of local industry
- {地場|じば}{産業|さんぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧ — nurturing local industry

- {地場|じば}{産業|さんぎょう}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ — locally produced goods
